data: Tesla's net income fell from $12,587 million in fiscal 2022 to $7,153 million in fiscal 2024, a decline of $5,434 million, or about 43.2%. The drop came despite revenue growing from $81,462 million to $97,690 million over the same period, as gross profit slipped from $20,853 million to $17,450 million and operating expenses rose from $7,197 million to $10,374 million. Net income attributable to common stockholders showed a similar decline, from $12,556 million to $7,091 million, or roughly 43.5%. For context, fiscal 2023 net income was $14,974 million, boosted by a $5,001 million income tax benefit.
